documents.title: Filing Of Application For Reclassification With Stock Exchanges
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited (SPARC) held its R&D Day conference call to provide updates on its prioritized clinical and preclinical pipeline programs, particularly focusing on oncology and immunology. Management highlighted progress on key assets like SCD-153 for alopecia areata and SBO-154, a MUC1-targeting ADC, alongside cost-reduction initiatives and alternative partnership structures like NewCos. The company also discussed regulatory updates regarding the pediatric rare disease voucher (PRV) and ongoing preclinical platforms in targeted delivery and synthetic lethality. Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd. submitted an investor presentation letter dated January 08, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

guidance.claim: The company expects to have safety and preliminary efficacy data for the SCD-153 Phase 1B trial in the fourth quarter of the calendar year.
guidance.quote: And this is an early signal seeking study and we expect to have safety and preliminary efficacy data by the fourth quarter of this calendar year and transition the program to a, hopefully to a larger Phase 2 trial thereafter.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of 2.4 milligrams per kilogram for SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of 2.4 milligrams per kilogram by the end of the third quarter of this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to identify the maximum tolerated dose for SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of 2026.
guidance.quote: We expect, as I mentioned, to expect to have the maximum tolerated dose, or the MTD, identified by the end of the third quarter of 2026, allowing us to proceed with cohort expansion by the end of the calendar year, and a potential early clinical proof of concept by the second half of 2027.

guidance.claim: Enrollment in all cohorts of the SCD-153 study is targeted to be completed in the third quarter of the year 2026.
guidance.quote: In terms of the key milestones, the enrollment in all cohorts of the study is targeted to be completed in the quarter 3 of the year 2026.

guidance.claim: Top-line results for the SCD-153 study are expected in Q4.
guidance.quote: Top line results are expected in Q4, and we plan to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study in the quarter 2 of the calendar year 2027.

guidance.claim: Management expects the initial court opinion regarding the pediatric rare disease voucher for Sezaby in the last quarter of this financial year.
guidance.quote: After exhausting all available reasonable options, we have approached the court for direction in February 2024 and we expect the courts initial opinion on this matter in the last quarter of this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to identify a development and commercialization partner for Vodobatinib CML by the end of this financial year.
guidance.quote: We are working towards identifying a partner by the end of this financial year.

guidance.claim: Atopic dermatitis 16-week topline results for Vibozilimod are expected in Q4 of FY25.
guidance.quote: Atopic dermatitis 16 week topline is expected in Q4 of FY25, while Psoriasis is expected to reach topline readout in Q1, FY26.

guidance.claim: The Phase IB study of SCD-153 in Alopecia Areata patients will be initiated in Q1 of FY26.
guidance.quote: The Phase IB study in Alopecia Areata patients will be initiated in the Q1 of FY26.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates an IND filing for SBO-154 by the end of Q4 FY2025.
guidance.quote: We anticipate an IND filing by the end of Q4 FY2025, followed by initiation of the Phase I study in the subsequent quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Operational spend is projected to go down from 31 million last year to 29 million this year.
margins_costs.quote: From 31 million last year, we are projected to go down to 29 million this year, even though we plan to scale our clinical program significantly.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has been funding early development using promoter-backed debt which is cumulatively 45 million-plus as of Q2 FY '26.
capital_allocation.quote: Plus we've been funding our early development using promoter-backed debt, which is cumulatively 45 million-plus now as of Q2 FY '26.

capital_allocation.claim: SPARC will receive 55% of Tiller's initial shares in two tranches issued in full within six months of signing the definitive agreement.
capital_allocation.quote: SPARC will receive 55% of Tiller’s initial shares in two tranches. This equity will be issued in full within six months of signing the definitive agreement.

risks_headwinds.claim: The original NDA for PDP-716 received a complete response letter driven by the OAI status of the third-party API vendor.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our original NDA received a complete response letter, driven by the OAI status of the third-party API vendor.

risks_headwinds.claim: Licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies for vodobatinib has been limited, largely on account of perceived market-size limitations.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies has been limited, largely on account of perceived market-size limitations, even with Asciminib’s commercial success and the rising industry interest in the next-generation TKI companies.

risks_headwinds.claim: In model-based analysis adjusted for drop-outs, the Vodobatinib drug arms marginally deteriorated and underperformed the placebo.
risks_headwinds.quote: But in model-based analysis, adjusted for drop outs, drug arms marginally deteriorated and underperformed the placebo.

risks_headwinds.claim: During the approval of Sezaby in 2022, the FDA denied SPARC the pediatric rare disease voucher.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the approval of Sezaby in 2022, FDA denied us the voucher and shared with us the agency justification supporting the denial which was built on a certain interpretation of the PRDV statute.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC plans to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study for SCD-153 in the second quarter of the calendar year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Top line results are expected in Q4, and we plan to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study in the quarter 2 of the calendar year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management is finalizing a funding plan to extend the cash window to FY '28 and hopes to complete that process in the first half of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We need now a significant additional resources to deliver the outcomes discussed in this presentation and we are in the process of finalizing a funding plan to extend the cash window to FY '28 and hope to complete that process in the first half of this calendar year.

management_commitments.claim: Management is working to complete the CRL response for PDP-716 by the second quarter of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are working very closely with the current management of Ocuvex, that’s their new name, to complete the CRL response by 2nd quarter of the next financial year and ensuring a successful launch once we get the approval which we hope to get before the turn of FY26.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to get an interim readout from the SCD-153 Phase IB study in Q1 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will get interim readout from this study in Q1 of FY27 and we target to initiate a global Phase IIB study in Q4 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
